description: Checks that ASIL/QM levels, hazards and safety goals in a technical design trace to the requirements documents and are not invented, raised or lowered.

numerical.label: Fully traceable
numerical.definition: Every safety classification claim is supported by the requirements or explicitly marked as a proposal. All source allocations are carried over; if the source allocates none, the design says so. Freedom from interference is addressed wherever ASIL and QM parts coexist.

numerical.label: Minor gaps
numerical.definition: No unsupported or contradicting level, but there is a gap: a source allocation is missing or only loosely restated, freedom from interference is not addressed for mixed ASIL/QM parts, the unallocated case is not stated explicitly, or informal objectives without IDs or ratings are listed as safety goals although the source has no HARA.

numerical.label: Unsupported additions
numerical.definition: The source allocations are reproduced correctly, but the design adds at least one level, or a hazard or safety goal with an ID or rating, that is not in the source and is presented as fact, or classifies the same function differently in different sections.

numerical.label: Invented or contradicting
numerical.definition: The design assigns an ASIL as fact where the source allocates none, raises or lowers a level relative to the source, places a source-rated safety function in a lower-integrity component, or contradicts an explicit QM or no-ASIL statement.
